{07 14 00}I'm going to work really
hard{01 00 00 0a 00} to make my new fish
happy!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma pingutan tõesti
kõvasti,{01 00 00 0a 00} et uus kala
oleks õnnelik!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm always happy to make
more friends, even if
they're, {01 00 00 05 00}uh,{01 00 00 05 00} fish.
{07 00 00}You should fill your house
with fish and make some
friends too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mul on alati hea meel uute
sõprade üle, isegi kui nad
on, {01 00 00 05 00}ee,{01 00 00 05 00} kalad.
{07 00 00}Sina peaksid ka oma maja
kaladega täitma ja sõpru
leidma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
